How to use · about this file

Open this HTML file in a browser. Tap anywhere on the card, or focus it and press Enter or Space. The front shows a pun or riddle; the back explains the wordplay and gives a situation and spoken example. “Present” hides the teacher controls; “Full screen” fills the display. Press Escape to leave presentation mode.

750 cards across 12 topics. Easy, Medium and Challenge are approximate vocabulary and reasoning guides, not curriculum assessments. Today’s card changes at midnight in Sydney and cycles through the selected set. Each card in that set appears once before the daily cycle repeats. Search and filters are kept only while this page is open.

This is a self-contained offline file. No accounts, sign-in, analytics, cloud storage, cookies or external requests. Everything needed to display the cards is included here.

Illustrations: OpenMoji (openmoji.org), CC BY-SA 4.0 (creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). Original colour SVG artwork embedded without visual changes. Wordplay collection and interface prepared for classroom use.
